artworks.title: The Ancient Temple
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting an architectural scene. The horizon is obscured by buildings, and the sky shows sketchy, swirling clouds. The main structure is an ancient-looking building with rounded Romanesque features, including columns and a curved facade. A bell and a cross are visible on the building. Two figures are at the base of a stone staircase, and a pile of branches or foliage is nearby. The etching has fine, expressive lines and a monochromatic color palette of brown ink on paper.

artworks.title: The Portrait Bust
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This is an image of a classical sculpture in a garden. The image features a sculpted bust of a person on a pedestal surrounded by foliage and trees. Inscribed text below the bust reads "Les Soirées de Rome." The drawing showcases detailed leaves, branches, and the sculpture texture, with a color palette of earthy tones.

artworks.title: The Well
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a historical setting. A person is operating a well within a stone structure, drawing water using a pulley system. The foreground includes trees with intricate branches, and the sky is filled with soft, linear clouds. Fine line work and cross-hatching create texture in the foliage and structures. The color palette is sepia, giving an antique feel. Various items are scattered in the foreground, and in the distance, a building and more figures can be seen.

artworks.title: The Triumphal Arch
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a man standing on a stone ledge holding a long staff, looking up a path. Another figure in a robe is at the base of the ledge. Tall ruins of an ancient structure obscure the horizon. The ruins feature intricate ornate designs. In the distance, a sky with a few clouds is visible. The brushstrokes are detailed with fine hatching for texture and shadow. The color palette is sepia tones. The scene is framed by foliage on either side.

artworks.title: The Post
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image is portrayed from an elevated point of view in a detailed engraving style. The horizon line is implied by the tops of the trees and the architectural ruins in the distance. The central focus is a tall wooden structure with a pulley and lantern. Two figures, a man and a woman, stand to the right. The scene is characterized by fine, precise lines and a monochromatic color palette of varying shades of brown.

artworks.title: The Ancient Gallery
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of an interior viewed from an elevated perspective within a large, arched structure. The scene features a group of figures inside, with no prominent horizon visible. The etching style is intricate, depicting textures of stone, brickwork, and wooden beams using fine lines. The color scheme is monochromatic, contrasting dark and light areas for depth. Two figures are near the entrance, with one climbing rubble and the other standing. More figures are seen in discussion or exploring further in the background. Linear strokes define the inner walls and ceiling, enhancing the sense of historical grandeur.

artworks.title: The Triumph of David
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient military scene. The scene depicts a group of soldiers carrying a trophy, which appears to be a head mounted on spears, as they are surrounded by onlookers and other soldiers. To the left, a procession of cavalry and infantry with banners and musical instruments is visible, with one figure gesturing towards the central gathering. In the foreground, a man is kneeling with his arms raised in a gesture, while a dog stands nearby. The background contains a distant cityscape with towers and buildings under a cloudy sky. On the right, there is a mountainous area with trees, and some animals can be seen in a fenced area. The drawing is executed in a detailed, line-based style, using a sepia-toned wash to add shading and depth.

artworks.title: Antique Subject
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a pastoral scene with classical figures. In the center, a satyr is shown interacting with a goat. To the left, a figure is holding a garland, possibly a deity, accompanied by a putto or cherub-like being. On the right, a bust is mounted on a plinth next to a tree. The drawing is executed in fine lines and shading, typical of classical or neoclassical themes. The composition is enclosed in an oval frame.

artworks.title: Saint Eustace
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 35.4 x 26 cm (13 15/16 x 10 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a hunter, his horse, and several dogs in a forest landscape. The image shows an outdoor scene where a hunter kneels in front of a horse surrounded by dogs. In the background, there is a dense forest with tall trees, some with leaves and some bare. Nearby, a deer with large antlers stands amidst the trees, gazing towards the foreground. In the distance, a castle is perched atop a rocky hill enveloped by trees. The artwork features intricate lines and detailed textures common in works from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Head of a Man
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 11.3 x 8.2 cm (4 7/16 x 3 1/4 in.)
support: 23.3 x 21.2 cm (9 3/16 x 8 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This drawing is a close-up view of a man's head and part of his neck. The man's head is turned to the right. He has a furrowed brow, a straight nose, a partially open mouth, and a thick, curly beard covering his lower face and chin. His hair is long and curly and seems to be flowing backward from his face. The drawing has been done in dark brown lines against plain, off-white paper.

artworks.title: Head of a Man
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 8 x 8.7 cm (3 1/8 x 3 7/16 in.)
support: 21.5 x 22.7 cm (8 7/16 x 8 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a drawing of a bearded man's head and shoulders in a slight left turn. The man has a detailed face with a prominent beard, curly hair, deep-set eyes, and a contemplative expression. He has a defined nose and a full head of hair framing his face. The man is wearing draped fabric around his shoulders or possibly a hood. The background is plain and neutral. The drawing style includes bold and fine lines, as well as shading for depth and texture.

artworks.title: Creusa Carrying the Gods of Troy
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white chalk on blue laid paper, with later framing line in brown ink
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a side profile, facing right from the waist up. She has a slight twist in her torso, with one arm crossed over the other. The woman has soft facial features, with a focus on her nose and slightly parted lips. She wears a headscarf that wraps her hair and a loose dress with ample folds and drapery. In the upper right corner, there are sketchy illustrations of hands. The background is a plain, muted tone.

artworks.title: Standing Youth with a Branch
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with orange tempera on vellum
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body illustration of a person standing upright. The individual is slightly turned to the side with their head facing forward. They have facial features, curly hair, and are wearing a long, flowing garment. They are holding a flower. A decorative arch surrounds their upper body with floral patterns against a warm red background. The background is a plain, textured surface.

artworks.title: Seated Girl with a Dog
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with orange tempera on vellum
artworks.description: The image shows a stylized drawing of a figure seated upright from head to toe. The figure has simple facial features, wavy hair with a flower garland, and wears a long dress. They hold a small dog in their arms. The drawing uses shades of grey and red, with a decorative background of swirling lines.

artworks.title: Simeon the Patriarch
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with incising throughout on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure in a mythical setting. The figure is seated among ruins, holding a sword and looking into the distance. There is an animal beside the ruins and a sculpture on a pedestal. In the background, there are detailed architectural structures.

artworks.title: Napoleon Views His Rising Star
artworks.medium: charcoal
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a robed figure standing before a giant face with closed eyes. The figure extends a hand towards a star on the forehead of the face. Flowing lines around the face suggest hair or a spiritual aura. The background is filled with curved lines and circular shapes, creating depth and movement. The medium appears to be pencil or charcoal, giving a soft texture to the image.

artworks.title: Market Scene
artworks.medium: black and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a market or tavern scene. The full-description: The painting is done in a monochromatic palette, using various shades of gray inks and washes. It depicts an array of still life elements and silhouettes of figures arranged in a busy composition. Central to the image is a large wooden cart with big wheels, featuring a barrel set atop the cart. Around the cart, various vessels and pots are scattered. Fabric structures form a canopy over the scene. The figures, rendered with loose brushstrokes, provide texture to the composition. This is in the style of Francisco Goya, known for his use of shadows and compositions.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with red-brown wash heightened with white on red-brown prepared laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a partially visible figure on the left, characterized by wings and a flowing garment, likely a robe. This figure is shown in a dynamic position, with one arm raised. On the right side, a person kneels with an arm extended towards the figure. The kneeling figure's face is partially visible with long hair cascading along the shoulders. Both figures are surrounded by an architectural setting with arched doorways, drapery, and furnishing elements. The color scheme is monochromatic in a reddish-brown tone, emphasizing intricate linework. The background features architectural elements suggesting an interior space with columns and arches.

artworks.title: Landscape (after Paul Bril)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash on  laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with a rugged, rocky terrain, delicate trees, loose and expressive brushstrokes, a muted color palette dominated by shades of brown, beige, and gray, and a layered effect created by branching trees and rocky formations.

artworks.title: Angels and Putti in the Clouds
artworks.medium: red and black chalk over graphite?, incised with stylus, on laid paper squared with red chalk
artworks.description: This drawing features figures and cherubs among the clouds. It depicts multiple celestial beings interacting in an ethereal environment, surrounded by swirling clouds. The drawing uses soft, flowing lines in red and black chalk to convey movement and lightness. The figures wear garments and wings, adding to the dynamic flair of the scene. The composition creates depth through layered arrangements of figures.

artworks.title: Study of a Man Walking towards the Left Holding a Staff
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash heightened with white over red chalk on blue paper
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a man seen from behind, mid-step, with his right arm extended forward. His head is turned to the left, revealing a profile of his face with a distinctive nose and a short, pointed beard. He wears a turban and a flowing garment that covers most of his body but leaves his arms bare. In his right hand, he holds a long staff. The background is a plain blue color.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Christ
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and touches of black chalk, heightened with white, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of numerous figures and symbolic creatures. The central figure is seated in a chariot, surrounded by a halo. Other figures are depicted holding palm branches or staffs. Above, a dove with rays of light shines downward. Below the chariot, a lion and an ox are depicted. The drawing is detailed with fine lines and shading, capturing movement and congregation among the figures.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 19.1 x 13.1 cm (7 1/2 x 5 3/16 in.)
support: 32.8 x 25.7 cm (12 15/16 x 10 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketchy landscape with figures near a body of water, viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The scene includes rocks, foliage, and small figures in the foreground and distance. The drawing is done in fine, loose lines with a color palette of brown, gray, and soft blue tones on aged paper.

artworks.title: Baccio Bandinelli
artworks.artist: Nicolò della Casa, after Baccio Bandinelli
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29.2 x 22 cm (11 1/2 x 8 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a bearded man seated, wearing a hat with a wide brim. He has a long, wavy beard and intense facial expression, with deep-set eyes and furrowed eyebrows. He wears a heavy robe with loose-fitting sleeves and a shell-shaped pendant around his neck. In his left hand, he holds a small sculpture of a muscular male figure. Behind him is a framed artwork showing three nude male figures and on the left background, there is another statue. The background consists of embellished linear textures.
